name: Fallen Survival🏹
desc:
Your base and items are saved on your last played server when you leave. 
Servers will reset bases and data - scheduled every Friday at 3 PM EST.
 
🏝️ Spawn on the beach with a boulder!
🪓 Harvest resources and craft new tools!
🏡 Build your base and defend from other players raiding!
⚙️ Discover new crafting recipes!
🗺️ Traverse the map with various vehicles and discover new monuments and loot!
⚔️ Fight military NPCs, bosses, and other players!
💣 Raid another player base and take their loot!

PvPvE hardcore base building Survival Game.
